item.title: Exclusive: Warren backs pause on advanced AI
item.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) is the latest prominent Democrat to back a pause on advanced artificial intelligence, her office told Axios exclusively.

item.title: Bessent: U.S. willing to discuss AI shared risks with China
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Axios the U.S. is open to discussing shared AI risks with China in talks this weekend.

item.title: U.S. diplomats hold talks with Houthis amid Red Sea crisis
item.description: American diplomats met Houthi representatives at the U.S. embassy in Oman over the weekend to discuss Red Sea tensions, a regional source said.
